title: Comprar cantidades
communication_goal: Pedir productos y cantidades en una tienda usando preguntas contables y no contables.
situation: Compras alimentos y aclaras cuánto necesitas y qué presentación prefieres.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: How much rice do you need?

dialogue.speaker: Shopkeeper
dialogue.english: I need a packet of rice and a bottle of oil.
dialogue.spanish: Necesito un paquete de arroz y una botella de aceite.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: How many apples do you want?

dialogue.speaker: Shopkeeper
dialogue.english: A kilo of apples, please. And two cans of beans.
dialogue.spanish: Un kilo de manzanas, por favor. Y dos latas de frijoles.

explanation_es: En una tienda, How many pregunta por productos contables: How many apples? How much pregunta por una sustancia o cantidad: How much rice? Puedes convertir un no contable en una cantidad con packet, bottle, can, box o kilo. Una forma natural de cerrar la compra es Anything else? y That's enough.
spanish_speaker_notes: No uses how many con rice, oil o water sin una unidad.
A kilo of apples cuenta una cantidad, aunque apples sea plural.
Anything else? equivale a '¿algo más?' en una tienda.
That's enough significa 'es suficiente', no 'eso es mucho'.

targets.text: How much rice do you need?

pronunciation.tip_es: En una tienda, habla con frases cortas y agrega please para sonar amable.

reading.title: The grocery order
reading.text: The shopkeeper needs a packet of rice, a bottle of oil, a kilo of apples and two cans of beans. The customer asks if he needs anything else. He says no, that is enough.

activities.instruction: Relaciona cada producto con una presentación adecuada.
Escucha: A kilo of apples, please. Elige la compra correcta.
activities.feedback: Kilo es la unidad y apples es el producto contable plural.

activities.instruction: Completa: How ___ cans of beans do you need?
activities.feedback: Cans es contable y está en plural.

activities.instruction: Ordena: need / how much / oil / you / do / ?
activities.answer: How much oil do you need?
activities.feedback: How much + sustantivo no contable + do you need?

activities.instruction: Corrige: How many rice do you need?
activities.answer: How much rice do you need?
activities.feedback: Rice es no contable; usa how much.

activities.instruction: Representa una compra: How much rice? A packet, please. Anything else? That's enough.
activities.target: How much rice? A packet, please. Anything else? That's enough.

activities.instruction: Lee The Grocery Order y responde: How many cans of beans are needed?
activities.feedback: La cantidad aparece en la segunda frase.

activities.instruction: La IA será un vendedor. Compra cinco productos, pide cantidades y responde Anything else? con naturalidad.
activities.scenario: Shopping for a dinner at a grocery store.
activities.ai_language: English; use realistic quantities and gentle corrections

activities.instruction: Haz una lista de compras para una comida. Graba el diálogo entre cliente y vendedor usando How much, How many, una unidad y Anything else?.
Completa: ___ apples? ___ rice? a ___ of oil; two ___ of beans.

must_demonstrate: elegir How much o How many
mastery_criteria.retry: Si confundes las preguntas, mira el sustantivo: plural contable = how many; sustancia o unidad = how much.
